entries.reason: Single Responsibility — The draft focuses on one concern: reflecting post-hook failure in process exit code across output modes.; Unambiguous Requirements — Expected outcomes are mostly testable (e.g., post-hook failure leads to exit code `1` per mode).; Complete Context — Key behaviors are written with condition/outcome pairs (e.g., “when post hook throws, exit code becomes 1”).; No Hardcoded Secrets — No credentials or secret material appear; this article is inapplicable to the draft content.; Prioritize Requirements — The draft contains multiple requirements/tests but does not define a priority order.; Impact on Existing Features — It explicitly discusses impacts and non-impacts (tests, `envelope.ok` semantics, scope boundaries).; Present Recommendations with Reasoning — Not every question has a clear recommendation plus explicit basis; Q3 is left as “要確認.”; Explore Before Asking — The draft cites specific source files/lines and resolves questions via code inspection.; Proactively Raise Related Implications — It proactively covers test impact, edge cases, alternatives, and future extension implications.; Confirm Brainstorm vs. Decision Before Critiquing — Alternatives are critiqued without explicitly confirming brainstorming vs. final decision mode first.; Capture Digressions in draft.md — No clear digression thread is present; this article is inapplicable here.; Draft Stays at Requirements Level — It includes implementation-level details (file paths, line-level behavior, control-flow notes, concrete test file additions).; Backward — Compatible CLI Interface — No command/option removal or semantic CLI change is proposed, so migration-plan requirement is inapplicable.
